299072.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Laguna Niguel
299072.note: The center's own 'Our Story': 'In the fall of 2005, Chabad of Laguna Niguel began in a humble living room'; Patch and Lubavitch.com: the center opened its doors in January 2006 (Rabbi Mendy and Kreinie Paltiel). In the 2016-17 Jewish OC Community Directory at 27631 La Paz Rd., Unit D; now 27500 La Paz Road.

316514.name: Chabad Jewish Center of South Huntington Beach
316514.note: Its own site: 'Chabad of South Huntington Beach was established by Rabbi Yossi and Yiska Berkowitz in 2005'; its Charidy campaign (https://www.charidy.com/chabadshb24): 'established in 2005'. (therebbesimpact.com's 2000 is for the couple.) In the 2016-17 Jewish OC Community Directory at 8511 Doremere Dr.; now 9461 Banning Avenue.

712606.name: Chabad of North Irvine
712606.note: In the 2016-2017 Jewish OC Community Directory (Orange County Jewish Life, http://jlifesgpv.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/JOCCD-2016-FINAL-OCJL-1.pdf): 'Chabad of North Irvine ... 5410 Trabuco Rd., Suite 130 ... Rabbi Elly Andrusier Founded; 2007.' A directory's year, so medium (therebbesimpact.com: 2007 for the center, 2002 for the couple; the listing number points to about 2008). In the 2016-17 Jewish OC Community Directory at 5410 Trabuco Rd., Suite 130; now 35 Clay, Irvine.
